thread:
maya: quick update — ran a multi-region p50/p95 sweep this morning for the new quantized Llama-2 variant (q4_0/q8_0) on A100 vs H100. results are weird: us-east p50~42ms p95~210ms, us-west p50~45ms p95~95ms, eu-west p50~60ms p95~230ms :rotating_light:

aj: can you drop the table or paste the CSV? curious about batch sizes and sequence length distribution.

maya: pasted the short dump below (seq=64, batch=1 by default):

```
region,gpu,quant,p50_ms,p95_ms,throughput_tok_s
us-east,A100,q8_0,42,210,1240
us-east,H100,q8_0,39,198,1360
us-west,A100,q8_0,45,95,1180
us-west,H100,q8_0,42,88,1310
eu-west,A100,q8_0,60,230,1000
eu-west,H100,q8_0,57,220,1085
```

maya: note we tried q4_0 on a subset — p50 slightly up (~5ms) but p95 improved on eu-west by ~20ms. full results uploaded: https://redwood-internal/charts/multi-region/1759004321-summary.png :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

liam: that p95 delta between us-east and us-west is suspicious. did we change edge routing / POP weights recently?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: traffic-split update completed — 2026-02-14T08:14Z — route policy "edge-weight-adjust-0214" moved 30% traffic us-east->us-west for canary.

liam: ah okay that matches timeframe. if 30% shifted, us-east backend might be seeing tail latencies due to hot shards or cold KV caches.

sanjay: also check kernel selection — H100 paths currently use cutlass-v2, A100 uses cutlass-v1 fallback for some ops. for short seqs that kernel mismatch can blow p95. try forcible kernel pin to cutlass-v2 on A100 for a run.

elaine: +1 on cache + kernel. also look at routing layer TLS/ALPN differences — eu-west goes through a different CDN POP that does TLS resumption poorly for large KV maps.

aj: i can run two quick tests: (1) force cutlass-v2 on A100 in us-east, (2) revert edge-weight to previous split and re-run sweep. which first?

maya: start with kernel pin in us-east (it’s lower-risk). command I used to repro at scale:

```
w rk -t12 -c200 -d30s --latency http://redwood-svc.internal/llm/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \n  -p post.json
```

aj: running kernel-pin now on two instances (us-east-1a, us-east-1b). will post numbers in ~10m.

liam: if kernel pin doesn't fix p95, next suspect is autoscaler burst config — we've seen p95 spikes when new pods spin up and cold-start KV loads hit CPU. check pod churn and cache-miss rate.

maya: noted. also, quantization seemed to help p95 on eu-west — so we should include q4_0 run in the next sweep.

ops-bot: observability-bot: alert created: #INC-2026-022 — multiregion p95 variance exceed threshold. linked charts: https://redwood-internal/alerts/INC-2026-022

aj: quick results from kernel pin (10m run): us-east A100 cutlass-v2 -> p50=44ms p95=120ms (huge improvement). i'll push full sweep in 20m.

maya: nice. that suggests kernel selection is primary. liam can you follow up on autoscaler churn separately?

liam: on it. i'll check pod churn logs and KV miss rates for the window when p95 spiked.

elaine: action items: aj — full sweep with q8/q4 across A100/H100 w/ kernel pin in us-east; liam — autoscaler+kv investigation; maya — update runbook with kernel preference guidance. assign: aj/liam/maya. :clipboard: 

maya: thanks — will update here when full sweep is done and attach final throughput/latency charts.
